source: A Traction Motor has malfunctioned. This will need to be repaired at a workshop, continue with reduced power.
target: 有台牵引电机出现故障。这需要在维修车间进行专门的维修，现在请降低动力继续行驶。

source: A door step has become stuck. Identify and manually operate the step to unstick it.
target: 有个车门踏板卡住了。找出故障踏板的位置，并通过手动操作解除卡死状态。

source: A passenger door has become stuck. Indentify and manually operate the door to unstick it.
target: 有扇乘客车门卡住了。找出故障车门的位置，通过手动操作解除卡死状态。

source: Insert and set the Brake Key to ON to activate the brakes.
target: 插入制动钥匙，并将其扭至“开”位置以激活制动。

source: Insert and set the Master Key to ON to activate this vehicle.
target: 插入主控钥匙并转到“开启”，激活车辆。

source: Insert the Reverser Handle and move the Reverser away from OFF to activate this cab.
target: 插入反向器手柄，并将反向器从“关闭”位置移开以激活该驾驶室。

source: Insert the reverser to allow directional control of this vehicle.
target: 插入反向器，启用本车的方向控制。

source: Let the Tap Changer Run Down to 0 and set the Throttle to OFF to reset the traction lock.
target: 让分接开关降至“0”档，然后将节流阀设置为“关”以重置牵引锁定。

source: Lower the shoes and close the circuit breaker to draw power from the third rail.
target: 降下集电靴并关闭电路断路器以从第三轨获取动力。

source: Move the Reverser away from KEY OUT to activate this cab.
target: 将反向器从“拔出钥匙”位置移开以激活该驾驶室。

source: Move the Reverser away from OFF to activate this cab.
target: 将反向器从“关闭”位置移开以激活该驾驶室。

source: PZB has triggered an emergency brake. A Trackside magnet was passed whilst exceeding the speed limit. When the vehicle has come to a stop press the Release control to acknowledge the alarm and release the brakes.
target: 列车安全系统（PZB）触发了紧急制动。你在超过速度限制的情况下通过了轨道旁的磁铁。等列车完全停下后，按下“缓解”按钮以确认警报，并缓解制动。
乘客紧急制动超驰控制

source: Raise the pantograph and close the circuit breaker to draw power from the overhead wires.
target: 升起集电弓并关闭电路断路器，从架空接触网获取动力。

source: Set the Compressor to ON to charge the air system before raising the pantograph.
target: 在升起集电弓前，将空气压缩机设置为“开启”，为空气系统充气。

source: Set the Compressor to ON to charge the air system to allow the brakes to release.
target: 将空气压缩机设置为“开启”，从而为空气系统充气，以缓解列车制动。

source: Set the Power Handle to IDLE to release the traction lock.
target: 将动力手柄设置到“空档”以解除牵引锁定。

source: Set the Power Handle to OFF to release the traction lock.
target: 将动力手柄设置到“关闭”以解除牵引锁定。

source: Set the Train Brake to DRIVING before applying power.
target: 施加动力前，将列车制动设置为“驾驶”。

source: Set the direction of travel to FORWARD or REVERSE before applying power.
target: 施加动力前，将列车行进方向设置到“前牵位”或“后牵位”。

source: Sifa has triggered a penalty brake. Press the Acknowledge button to release the brakes.
target: 失知制动触发了惩罚性制动。按下“确认”按钮以缓解此制动。

source: Sifa has triggered a penalty brake. Reset the SIFA Pedal to release the brakes.
target: 失知制动触发了惩罚性制动。重置失知制动踏板，以缓解此惩罚性制动。

source: Tempomat has faulted. Try turning it off and on again.
target: 定速巡航控制出现了故障。重启一下试试。

source: The Handbrake has faulted and become applied. It will need releasing again.
target: 手制动出现了故障，自行施加了制动。需要重新缓解手制动。

source: The Handbrake must be released on this vehicle before attempting to drive.
target: 需要缓解这辆车上的手制动，然后才能尝试开动本车。

source: The Main Circuit Breaker has opened. Try closing the Main Circuit Breaker again.
target: 主电路断路器打开了。试试重新关掉主电路断路器。

source: The Pantograph has dropped. Try raising the Pantograph again.
target: 集电弓掉下来了。试试重新升起集电弓。

source: The Parking Brake must be released on this vehicle before attempting to drive.
target: 需要缓解这辆车上的驻车制动，然后才能尝试开动本车。

source: The Windshield Wiper appears to have become stuck.
The circuit breaker has unexpectedly opened. Follow the pantograph deployment procedure to regain power.
target: 电路断路器意外开启。请按照集电弓部署流程进行操作，从而恢复供电。

source: The circuit breaker has unexpectedly opened. Follow the shoe deployment procedure to regain power.
target: 电路断路器意外开启。请按照供电靴部署流程进行操作，从而恢复供电。

source: The coupler hatch has become stuck. Try closing it again before re-opening.
target: 车钩口卡住了。请先关闭车钩口，再尝试重新打开它。

source: The passenger lights have turned off.
target: 乘客车厢灯光被关上了。

source: There is an active Traction Lock. Power is currently unavailable.
target: “牵引锁定”已激活。当前无法施加动力。

source: This passenger door has been unstuck.
target: 这扇乘客车门已经恢复正常了。
时刻表与驾驶室中央灯光

source: Wait for the Air Compressor to charge the brake system.
target: 等待空气压缩机为制动系统充气。
